business_problem: Perplexity needed to customize frontier models for a search experience that returns direct answers instead of links, but rapid model releases, high query volume, and the need for low latency and high throughput made continuous post-training and retrieval optimization a core challenge.
solution_summary: Perplexity used NVIDIA NeMo to create and refresh its Sonar family of online language models for the company's answer engine. The team relies on NeMo to scale supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization, and proximal policy optimization across a range of model sizes and architectures, including Llama and Mistral families. Retrieval-augmented generation connects those tuned models to live source material so answers stay current and grounded, while NeMo's distributed training support lets Perplexity experiment quickly after new open-source models appear. The same stack is also used to fine-tune open-source embedding models that improve the retrieval layer itself. This architecture lets Perplexity update both generation and retrieval in a matter of days, rather than leaving a web-scale search product tied to static generic models that are slower and less factual.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NeMo
solution_components.role: Provides the distributed post-training framework for Sonar and retrieval-model tuning.

solution_components.name: Llama
solution_components.role: Serves as one of the frontier base-model families Perplexity fine-tunes for search.

solution_components.name: Mistral
solution_components.role: Provides another base-model family that Perplexity customizes for answer quality and efficiency.

solution_components.name: Sonar
solution_components.role: Delivers the production online language models used in Perplexity's answer engine.

data_flow: Search intent and retrieved web context flow into Sonar models that were post-trained in NeMo with SFT, DPO, and PPO; tuned embedding models improve retrieval quality; and the resulting RAG pipeline returns concise grounded answers to users and enterprise integrations.
business_outcome: Perplexity processed 340 million queries a month, integrated into more than 1,500 organizations, and used NeMo-based tuning to produce Sonar models that improved search quality by 20% over newly released base models within days while preserving the low latency users expect.
